_comment: Where this install looks for its online home (the joelc67/hero-companion GitHub repository). Every phone-home feature (bug reports, champion submissions, update checks) fires only on a user click - the app never sends anything on its own.
_bug_report_key_comment: Web3Forms PUBLIC access key. It can ONLY deliver a message to the developer's verified inbox - it cannot send elsewhere or expose anything, so it is safe in this public client. Lets anyone report a bug with no account. Empty = fall back to the GitHub issue link.
